job.title: Regional Business Development Manager - CENTRAL
job.description:
Location: Field-based

Region: North Region - Regional Hub - Kenilworth

Package: £50,000-£55,000, OTE of £80,000, plus car allowance.

 

The role

You drive new business development across your assigned geographical territory, focusing on larger, more complex commercial opportunities where face-to-face engagement creates greater value than a desk-based approach alone.

This isn't simply an appointment-led field sales role. You'll proactively create your own opportunities through prospecting, canvassing, networking and direct customer engagement, building a strong presence within your local market. You report to the Head of National Field Sales and work as part of the Field Sales function.

 

Your partnership

You'll be partnered with an Outbound Sales Executive, combining desk-based prospecting with regional field expertise to develop opportunities collaboratively across your territory.

 

What the role demands

  • Develop and execute a regional new business plan.
  • Prospect for larger and strategically valuable commercial customers.
  • Meet decision-makers face to face across your territory.
  • Canvass target locations and approach prospective customers directly.
  • Build regional networks, referrals and market intelligence.
  • Work closely with your aligned Outbound Sales Executive on target lists, campaigns and qualified referrals.
  • Sell Commercial Fuels, AdBlue, Fuel Cards and Telemetry, developing multi-product propositions where appropriate.
  • Coordinate complex commercial requirements across internal NWF stakeholders.
  • Maintain a high-quality regional pipeline with accurate CRM records, forecasts and clear next actions.
  • Deliver new account, volume, GM and product penetration objectives.
  • Manage new commercial customers through the agreed acquisition period before structured transition into Retention.

 

What you bring

  • Proven B2B field-based new business experience.
  • Strong prospecting and relationship-building capability.
  • Confidence opening doors and creating opportunities independently.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills.
  • The ability to manage a large geographical territory effectively.

 

You'll likely be someone who enjoys building relationships in the field, creating opportunities through proactive business development and converting larger commercial prospects into profitable long-term customers.

If you're motivated by winning new business, solving customer challenges and delivering measurable commercial results, we'd like to hear from you. Every conversation is handled in confidence.

job.title: Commercial Contracts Specialist
job.description:
Andover, Hampshire | Hybrid Working | £45,000–£52,000 + Bonus & Benefits

 

The Opportunity

Are you commercially astute, confident reviewing contracts and skilled at spotting risks before they become costly problems?

We're recruiting a Commercial Contracts Specialist for a successful, rapidly growing business operating within the engineering and critical power sectors. Despite its continued growth, the company has retained its close-knit, supportive culture where individual contributions are recognised, ideas are welcomed and employees have a genuine opportunity to make an impact.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of a key commercial function, working closely with senior decision-makers and playing a direct role in protecting profitability and supporting the company's continued success.

 

The Role

Reporting to the CFO and working closely with the Sales, Projects and Finance teams, you'll be responsible for ensuring projects are commercially viable and contractual risks are understood and managed before commitments are made.

Your responsibilities will include:

•             Reviewing and negotiating customer contracts and subcontract agreements to protect the company's commercial interests.

•             Assessing project costs, margins and profitability to ensure proposed contracts are financially sound.

•             Identifying contractual, financial and delivery risks and recommending practical solutions.

•             Working with Sales and Projects to ensure proposed commitments, scope and deliverables are realistic and achievable.

•             Supporting commercial negotiations with customers and suppliers.

•             Contributing to the development and improvement of commercial processes and controls.

 

About You

We're looking for someone with strong commercial awareness, sound judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively when something doesn't stack up.

Ideally, you'll have:

•             A recognised qualification in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Construction Management or a related discipline. However, candidates who are qualified by experience, with demonstrable commercial expertise, are equally encouraged to apply.

•             At least three years' relevant experience in a commercial, contracts or pre-contract role.

•             Experience reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts, ideally within engineering, M&E, construction or another project-based environment.

•             A good understanding of project costing, margins, profitability and commercial risk.

•             Strong analytical, negotiation and communication skills.

•             The ability to build effective relationships, influence decisions and work independently.

Experience with NEC or JCT contracts, specialist engineering projects or M&E installations would be advantageous, but is not essential.

 

What's on Offer?

•             £45,000–£52,000 salary, depending on experience

•             Hybrid working based in Andover, Hampshire

•             Bonus scheme

•             25 days' holiday, increasing with service

•             Health cash plan

•             Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits

•             Ongoing training and professional development

•             A supportive, family-oriented culture within an ambitious, growing business

•             The opportunity to have your contribution recognised and genuinely influence how things are done

job.title: Head of Customer Retention & Growth
job.description:
Senior customer leadership role managing the Central Region.

Vested Talent is appointing a Head of Regional Customer Retention & Growth for an established UK distribution business. The business serves both B2C and B2B customers, with a significant active customer base.

Location: within commuting distance of Kenilworth, Warwickshire.

Up to £70,000 base + 25% bonus + company car allowance.

 

The role

You lead customer services, client services and account management for the Central region. You own the region’s customer outcomes: service quality, retention, revenue and margin across domestic and commercial accounts. A large share of the business’s existing customer revenue runs through your team and the bonus is tied to regional performance.

You report to the Director of Customer Retention & Growth. You work alongside the Regional Head of Operations, your peer, so that service commitments to customers are delivered on the ground.

 

Your team

  • Around 20 people, rising to 23 at seasonal peak
  • Two direct reports: an Internal Customer Retention & Growth Manager and a Senior Regional Key Account Manager
  • Customer services, internal account management and key account management, run to one standard

 

What the role demands

  • Every customer contact is handled well and leaves the relationship stronger. Where there is a chance to do more for the customer, your team takes it.
  • You track service, retention, revenue and margin together, and you step in early when any of them drifts.
  • You use customer and margin data to decide where the team’s effort goes.
  • You raise problems early instead of absorbing them.
  • You recruit, develop and plan succession across the regional team.

 

What you bring

  • Leadership of a multi-team customer operation of 15+ people, with P&L or margin accountability.
  • A track record of managing managers.
  • Experience in customer services, a contact centre, client services or account management.
  • Comfort with commercial data and the confidence to act on it.

 

You will likely come from a business where customers range from high-volume domestic buyers to long-term managed accounts. You may currently be a Head of Customer Services, Head of Customer Retention, Head of Account Management or Senior Contact Centre Leader looking for a broader regional remit.

If you’ve led a service operation that keeps customers and grows them, we’d like to hear from you. Every conversation is handled in confidence.

A parallel role is open in the South region, based near Eastleigh, Hampshire.
